title: Pullback of locally constant finite module sheaves
statement:
Let $f:V\to X$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and constant ring sheaves $A_X,A_V$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The module inverse image $f^*$ is that of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], with the canonical coefficient-ring isomorphism $f^{-1}A_X\cong A_V$ of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Suppose $F$ is an $A_X$-module sheaf which is locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] with finite module models: it admits a pro-etale covering $\{U_j\to X\}$ and isomorphisms $F|_{U_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{U_j}$, where every $M_j$ is a finite $A$-module. Then on the base-changed covering $\{V\times_XU_j\to V\}$ there are isomorphisms of module sheaves
$$
 (f^*F)|_{V\times_XU_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{V\times_XU_j}.
$$
In particular, $f^*F$ is locally constant with the same finite module models. This assertion includes empty schemes and empty covering members.

proof.text: Restrict each localized ringed module sheaf to constant scalars. Use the already proved ConstantScalarComparison.restriction, restrictionFullyFaithful, constantComparisonHom and constantComparisonHom_isIso declarations from the coefficient-constructibility module: these identify the given sheafification model with the fixed-module constant sheaf, preserving the actual module M_i. Use the concrete slice equivalence of lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization and upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction to identify this localized fixed-module trivialization with a trivialization of (U_i.hom)^*G on the small pro-etale site of U_i.left. The constant-sheaf comparison of an equivalence of sites preserves M_i exactly.

Choose b_i to be the structure map of W_i=u_f(U_i). The triangle equation for a_i identifies its underlying scheme map with U_i.hom. Rewrite membership using ProEt.mem_precoverage_iff. Stability under base change, via Mathlib Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback, proves that the b_i cover V. The square has p_i=pullback.fst and q_i=pullback.snd, with q_i followed by f equal to p_i followed by U_i.hom.

Apply proEtaleModuleRestriction_pullback of lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-pullback-encoding to identify the specified actual tensor module pullback with fixed-module inverse image after restriction to constant scalars. By upperStarComp on both sides of the cartesian square and its commutativity equation, q_i^*f^*G is isomorphic to p_i^*(U_i.hom)^*G. Apply p_i^* to the model from the first step. The base-change functor for p_i preserves terminal objects; the existing constantSheafsheafPullbackIso and the construction-to-abstract pullback comparison identify its image of the constant sheaf M_i with the constant sheaf M_i.

Transport the resulting constant-model isomorphism back across the concrete slice equivalence at W_i, then lift it through the fully faithful localized constant-scalar restriction. Compose with the same constantComparisonHom to obtain (f^*F).over W_i isomorphic to proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver V A W_i M_i. The constructed b_i, its covering property, and these isomorphisms give the conclusion of IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf by its definition. Every model is exactly the supplied M_i, so its assumed finiteness is unchanged. All constructions apply to empty schemes and covering members and to empty index sets.

lean.statement: theorem proEtaleConstantModulePullback_locallyConstant {V X : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ X) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (F : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (proEtaleConstantRing X A))) (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt) (a : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)) (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows U a ∈ (ProEt.precoverage X).coverings _) (M : I → ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) (hfinite : ∀ i : I, Finite (M i)) (htrivial : ∀ i : I, Nonempty (F.over (U i) ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver X A (U i) (M i))) : ∃ b : ∀ i : I, (proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i) ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 V), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i : I ↦ (proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) b ∈ (ProEt.precoverage V).coverings _ ∧ (∀ i : I, Nonempty ((proEtaleConstantModulePullback f A F).over ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver V A ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) (M i))) ∧ IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf V A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback f A F)
